svg.aria-label: BCBC 2024 Article 9.9.8.2 Number of Required Exits
svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.9.8.2 Number of Required Exits
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.9 MEANS OF EGRESS
Number of Required Exits

g.text: A far point in the floor area
At least 2 exits: travel distance to the
nearest exit not more than the table value
MAXIMUM TRAVEL DISTANCE TO THE NEAREST EXIT, AND SENTENCE (2)
Sentence (2): a single exit is permitted from each storey
of a building of 1 or 2 storeys, where
the floor area and travel distance conform to Article 9.9.7.4.,
and the occupant load served by an exit facility is 60 max.

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
At least 2 exits are provided from every floor
area, spaced so that the travel distance to
the nearest exit is not more than
(a) 40 m (131′-2¾″) for business and personal
services occupancies, (b) 45 m (147′-7⅝″) for all
occupancies where the floor area is sprinklered,
and (c) 30 m (98′-5⅛″) for all other occupancies.
Except as provided in Sentence (2) and Subsection
A single exit is permitted from each storey in
buildings of 1 and 2 storeys in building
height
Provided the floor area and travel distance
conform to Article 9.9.7.4., and the total
occupant load served by an exit facility does not
exceed 60 persons. Except as provided in
Subsection 9.9.9.
Drawn: an open floor area with an exit at each end, walls cut low. Not to scale.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.9.8.2. (page 9-52)
